name: Whats2API Bridge
description: WhatsApp via whats2api.com — list/start/stop sessions, send messages and reactions, and ingest every inbound event (messages.upsert, connection.update, group-participants.update, ...) through an OXS webhook.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Long-lived API token from the whats2api.com dashboard (Dashboard → API Tokens). Shown only once at creation. 64 hex chars.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: Override only if you proxy whats2api.com. Must start with https://.

default_connection_id.title: Default connection ID
default_connection_id.description: Optional connection to use when a tool call omits connection_id.

log_inbound_events.title: Persist every inbound event
log_inbound_events.description: If true, every whats2api event is stored in the events table.

inbound_webhook_key.title: Inbound webhook key (DEPRECATED — kept for back-compat, no UI exposure)
inbound_webhook_key.description: Legacy field, no longer read or enforced. Exists only so old settings files load without error.

webhook_url_token.title: Webhook URL token
webhook_url_token.description: User-defined token that replaces the auto-generated <token> in /api/ext/whats2api_bridge/webhook/<token>. Type any string; only URL-safe characters (A–Z, a–z, 0–9, '-', '_') are accepted because the value goes into the URL path. Persisted to data/extensions/whats2api_bridge/inbound_webhook_token (mode 0600) and survives restarts; takes effect on the dispatcher immediately after save.

analyzer_enabled.title: Conversation Analyzer — enable
analyzer_enabled.description: When true, a periodic scheduled task runs in the background, reads recent WhatsApp conversations, and produces a chat-session summary the operator can review (manage_notes / manage_tasks / manage_calendar). WhatsApp write tools are blocked — the agent never replies for you.

analyzer_interval_minutes.title: Conversation Analyzer — interval (minutes)
analyzer_interval_minutes.description: How often the analyzer runs while enabled. 30 is a sane default; lower values hit the LLM more often.

analyzer_lookback_hours.title: Conversation Analyzer — lookback (hours)
analyzer_lookback_hours.description: Time window the analyzer inspects on each run. 24 = past day.

analyzer_min_messages.title: Conversation Analyzer — min messages per chat
analyzer_min_messages.description: Skip chats with fewer than N messages in the lookback window. Cuts noise.

analyzer_endpoint_id.title: Conversation Analyzer — endpoint ID
analyzer_endpoint_id.description: Model endpoint to use (e.g. 'default', an OpenAI endpoint, a local Ollama). Empty = use the default endpoint configured in Settings → Models.

analyzer_model.title: Conversation Analyzer — model
analyzer_model.description: Model name on the chosen endpoint. Empty = endpoint default.

analyzer_prompt.title: Conversation Analyzer — system prompt
analyzer_prompt.description: Custom instructions for the analyzer. The placeholder {lookback_hours} is replaced with the configured lookback. Leave default for sane behavior.
